item_name: Rothco Five Gallon Collapsible Water Carrier
item_short_desc: Stay hydrated wherever you go with Rothco's 5 Gallon Collapsible Water Carrier. Made from durable see-through polyethylene, this lightweight water carrier is designed for convenience and practicality. It features a sturdy on/off spigot for easy water access, a comfortable carry handle for effortless portability, and a collapsible design that folds flat when not in use. Ideal for camping, hiking, outdoor adventures, or emergency preparedness, this water carrier offers ample capacity for your hydration needs.
